About.title: Technology that transforms the future
About.description: We are an institute in Fortaleza, Brazil, dedicated to technology education, combining sustainability and innovation to empower critical, creative and conscious citizens.
About.mission: to turn electronic waste into sustainable technology education for the people who need it most.

robotics.title: Educational robotics
robotics.description: Sustainable robotics workshops for children aged 8 to 14, with kits made from recycled waste.

inclusion.description: Computer literacy and repair courses using recovered equipment.
inclusion.imageAlt: Young people repairing computers in a lab

events.description: Interactive exhibitions, robot battles and talks that bring the community closer to technology.
